reading.body:
WeRide's public record is a filing cadence and a patent portfolio, not a compute or power footprint. Eight 6-K filings between July and September 2026 show a company reporting frequently to US regulators while listed on Nasdaq.

The patents cluster on the vehicle side: obstacle recognition, semantic-map obstacle location, road-map generation for autonomous navigation, and buffer management in data communication. That is perception, mapping, and onboard data handling. The most recent grant in the set is from June 2025, so the record shows a granted portfolio of 15, not a current filing rate.

Autonomous driving is a compute consumer at the edge, in the vehicle, and in training for the models behind perception and mapping. The data here does not quantify any of that. It contains no fleet size, no miles driven, no data-center capacity, no power contract, and no chip supply detail, so it cannot support a claim about WeRide's draw on the grid or its position in the compute constraint.

What the record does establish is thin but concrete: a Guangzhou-based, for-profit Nasdaq issuer, industry-classified under computer integrated systems design, with 15 granted US patents and a steady 6-K rhythm. The company's own description of 60 cities and 13 countries comes from its site, not from the filings, and should be read as a self-report.

profile_text.body:
WeRide Inc. is a commercial-stage company that develops autonomous driving technologies from Level 2 to Level 4, according to its own site. It describes itself as a global leader in autonomous driving technology with a business footprint spanning more than 60 cities across 13 countries, and says it offers a portfolio of five core products, including Robotaxi. The company points to its WeRide One universal autonomous driving technology platform, a self-developed foundational toolchain, and what it calls an industry-leading accumulation of real-world operational data.

WeRide is listed on Nasdaq under the ticker WRD and on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under 0800. Its site states that it has been recognized in Fortune's 2026 Change the World and 2025 Future 50 lists. The company is headquartered in Guangzhou and is a for-profit public company. No lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for it.
